about: The frozen halt, inspect, resume and cancel proof every structural move reruns. Each entry names one test by its file, relative to the repository root, and its full name: its describe blocks and its own name joined by ' > '. An agent-parameterized test has one entry per agent; `agent` is null for a test of the packed runtime, which drives no agent. A move that relocates or renames a listed test updates its entry here and nowhere else.

tests.name: a halted Engine run on claude > a refused step runs again on resume; a step that completed normally does not
tests.proves: halt: the run stops at its missing-source pause, and the resume runs the refused step again

tests.name: a halted Engine run on codex > a refused step runs again on resume; a step that completed normally does not
tests.proves: halt: the run stops at its missing-source pause, and the resume runs the refused step again

tests.name: a halted Engine run on codex > a poll that finds no ruling resumes nothing, and the watch ends when it is stopped
